            }
            word.clear();
        } else {
            word += c;
        }
        i++;
    }
    
    if (inside) {
        if (word.length() > 0) ins++;
    } else {
        if (word.length() > 0) lon = max(lon, (int)word.length());
    }
    
    cout << lon << " " << ins << endl;
    return 0;
